_about: C-34: TV POWER codes by brand, for FLARE's search when the remote is lost. Written here from each protocol's own published command table, not copied from a code database: Sony SIRC is device 1 (TV) with command 21 (power), 46 (on) and 47 (off), sent 12 bits with SIRC's repeats; Samsung's, LG's (NEC), Panasonic's (Kaseikyo) and Toshiba's (NEC) power commands; Vizio uses LG's NEC code. A start: brands are added as their codes are checked, and a larger list only once its licence lets it live in this public repo.
